title: Supplementary Materials - Data-Driven Contact-State Estimation of an Endoskeleton-Reinforced Soft Pneumatic Gripper Using Sigmoidal Pressure–Bending Response Analysis
rights: CC BY 4.0, per fixed archive metadata. Credit the listed depositors. Only newly computed tables and source identifiers, hashes and references are included.

identifiers: Supplementary Materials - Data-Driven Contact-State Estimation of an Endoskeleton-Reinforced Soft Pneumatic Gripper Using Sigmoidal Pressure–Bending Response Analysis

queries.route: Matched the existing concept DOI, selected fixed record 23005291 (v4), read two methods PDFs and both data archives.

scope: Physically acquired pressure-regulator, potentiometer and one/three flex-sensor experiments. S1 contains six sensor series, S2 has 17 grasp series and 17 derived fitted tables. The measurement CSVs include postprocessed channels; PNGs, FE plots and the video are not time-series inputs to this audit. The supplementary video was not checked.
methods: Part 1 §2.3 Tables S5/S6 and §3.1; Part 2 programs S1, S2, S4 and S5. S1 maps its potentiometer readout to pressure; Position1 explicitly labels that channel as predicted. The three-finger logger S5 computes System Pressure from potentiometer voltage using 0.5263*V^2 + 18.5199*V + 1.9964 and prints three decimals. The separately described pressure-display calibration is not an independent continuous pressure trace.
cleaning: Drop only blank/noncomplete rows and report both counts. Timestamps are parsed at their archived minute resolution; repeated stamps may involve several observations. Near-identical series share exactly equal leading rows across all exported columns, including timestamps: SmallerCake and SmallerCakeCrush share 34 leading complete rows, followed by a differing row. This is a shared prefix, not evidence that the entire recordings are identical or that the extra rows are independent trials.
results: All 975 complete S2 grasp measurement rows across 17 records agree to three decimals with the published polynomial. S1 has 350 complete rows in 6 records. There are 51 parameter-fit rows among the separate S2 summaries. No physical saturation flag or measured actuator-side pressure wave is present in these CSVs. Event/contact labels inferred from bending are estimates, with no independent measured contact force in this release.
reproduce: Python 3: put both original ZIPs in DATA. Run python derive_gripper.py DATA OUT.
